references.text: Prohibition against sexual relations with a sister, whether she is the daughter of your father or your mother, born in the home or outside.
Prohibition against sexual relations with a half-sister, the daughter of your father's wife who was born to your father.
The penalty for anyone who takes his sister, whether the daughter of his father or his mother, and has sexual relations with her—they shall be cut off.
Amnon, David's son, raped his half-sister Tamar, an example of violating this prohibition.
The account of Amnon and Tamar, where Amnon commits incest with his half-sister, which is directly linked to the prohibition in this passage.
